normalized_output:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER left=3.
LOOP (left>=0) { IF (values[left]<0) { break. } left-=1. }
NUMBER right=4.
LOOP (right>=0) { IF (values[right]==2) { break. } right-=1. }
NUMBER result=2.
LOOP (right<5) { IF (values[right]%2==0) { result+=1. } right+=1. }
DISPLAYNL(result).
